authorityBoundary: This registry supports bounded evaluation. It does not establish GAEP acceptance, superiority, conformance, certification, enterprise readiness, safety, compliance, release, or production authority.

claimAssurance.claim: GAEP separates candidate, acceptance, commit, and broader organizational authorities.
claimAssurance.prohibitedInterpretation: Does not prove organizational authority assignment or acceptance.

claimAssurance.claim: The current Product Journey exposes a canonical typed checkpoint/substep contract used by sibling projections.
claimAssurance.scope: VS Code Studio, Chat/adoption, export, protocol, Guideline projections
limitations: Business outcomes and independent assurance are not established
claimAssurance.prohibitedInterpretation: Does not mean target-only checkpoints are implemented.

claimAssurance.claim: GAEP provides current deterministic Source Intake, Baseline, and Provenance workflows with explicit authority boundaries.
limitations: Removal, exclusion, supersession, and guided unavailability transitions are unavailable
claimAssurance.prohibitedInterpretation: Does not prove Source truth, authority, rights, completeness, or all source-change support.

claimAssurance.claim: GAEP currently supports end-to-end implementation, CI/CD, release, deployment, and operations governance.
counterEvidence: Current runtime ends at P0–P4 readiness and handoff
claimAssurance.prohibitedInterpretation: Must never be presented as a current capability.

claimAssurance.claim: GAEP conforms to the standards referenced by its methodology catalog.
limitations: Several references are ED1; no authorized conformance assessment exists
claimAssurance.prohibitedInterpretation: No conformance, certification, endorsement, compliance, or enterprise-readiness claim is permitted.
